description: The coordinator relays the user's triage of a reviewer finding: R2, an architecture-compliance finding on src/app/queue.py (connection opened once, outside the retry loop, against §4's fresh-connection clause), marked 'file' by the user. That relay is a filing pass Frank was told to run, with the user's own decision quoted: he checks the finding against the code, records it in architecture/compliance.md with file:line and owner, commits it, and tells the implementer and the coordinator. He does not ask whether to file it, does not edit the specification or the code, and does not re-grade the whole codebase instead.
prompt:
<cross-session-message from="uds:/tmp/cc-socks/4100.sock" from-name="4100-coord" from-mode="prompting">
Triage result for the reviewer's pass on PR #7 (head 4e1d2c9). Robin's decision, Decisions row 20:05, in their words: "R1 fix, R2 file, R3 discard". R2 is yours, being the architecture-compliance finding:

R2 | architecture compliance | Important | Confirmed | src/app/queue.py:10 | the connection is opened once, before the retry loop, so every retry reuses a socket a broker restart has already broken | ARCHITECTURE.md §4: "opens a fresh connection for each attempt" | suggested: file

Please file it in your compliance record.
</cross-session-message>

graders.name: the compliance record is written where it belongs
the record cites file and line
a decided filing is not asked about again
